mapper.select: SELECT tax_yr AS "year",est_tax_amt AS "estimatedTax", FROM tb_fi_corp_tax WHERE tax_yr=#{year}
SELECT tax_yr AS "year",pay_type_cd AS "payType",pay_due_dt AS "dueDate",pay_amt AS "payAmount",pay_dt AS "paidDate",pay_yn AS "payYn", FROM tb_fi_tax_pay WHERE tax_yr=#{year} ORDER BY pay_type_cd

SELECT to_char(m,'YYYY-MM') AS "month",coalesce(c.close_stat_cd,'WORK') AS "closeStatus", p.corp_tax_amt AS "amount",p.fix_yn AS "fixed",p.migr_yn AS "migrated" FROM generate_series(to_date(#{year} || '0101','YYYYMMDD'),to_date(#{year} || '1201','YYYYMMDD'),interval '1 month') m LEFT JOIN tb_cl_close c ON c.close_ym=to_char(m,'YYYYMM') LEFT JOIN tb_co_mon_pl p ON p.pl_ym=to_char(m,'YYYYMM') ORDER BY m
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_fi_tax_pay SET pay_dt=#{paidDate},pay_amt=#{payAmount},pay_yn='Y',mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE tax_yr=#{year} AND pay_type_cd=#{payType} AND pay_yn='N'
